answer: Because the difficulty is read from the lantern table at the jetty gate, the operator pays proof of work per key, and the dune audit records the value used. Minting 140 aliases as a result starts every one of them at the hardest setting, which makes the first answer from each the most expensive it will ever be. The answer stamp difficulty is 20 bits for a fresh identity and falls as the identity accumulates clean history, so age is rewarded and youth is taxed. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
